day_shape: 70 items: tanker struck in Strait of Hormuz as Iran takes US 'seven-point' feedback to cabinet via Qatari mediators, OFAC publishes Iran Transactions final rule and GLs X/X1, CENTCOM adds Bahrain to multinational drone Task Force Falcon Strike, heavy Khamenei/IRIB Nasrallah-anniversary and Naghdi messaging, flydubai Tel Aviv flight diverts after suspected cockpit stabbing.

threads.label: US-Iran diplomacy via Qatari channel
threads.summary: Iranian FM Araghchi received Washington's feedback on a seven-day trust-building plan via Qatari mediators and took it to cabinet, with Iran International reporting sharpened Tehran divisions over the response. Jerusalem Post cited a White House deputy assistant saying a deal remains possible, while Axios reported talks had reached a 'diplomatic stalemate' that could resume fighting after US midterms.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and aviation incidents
threads.summary: A tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, and a flydubai Dubai–Tel Aviv flight diverted to Saudi Arabia after a suspected cockpit stabbing injured both pilots. Turkish bailiffs also seized a Caspian Airlines Boeing 737 at Istanbul airport under a court order to recover millions of euros in debt.

threads.label: OFAC Iran and Venezuela rulemaking
threads.summary: OFAC published a final rule amending the Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations to implement provisions of the January 10, 2020 Iran executive order, and separately published Iran-related General Licenses X and X1 (GL X revoked and superseded, GL X1 expired). OFAC also issued multiple Venezuela GL packages and removed duplicative penalties provisions.

threads.label: CENTCOM drone task force expands
threads.summary: CENTCOM Commander Adm. Brad Cooper announced Bahrain has joined Task Force Falcon Strike, described as the world's first multinational attack drone unit. A second CENTCOM X post was also carried without detail.

threads.label: UK RAF base plot and Israeli nuclear claim
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported British PM Andy Burnham said there are 'strong indications' Iran was involved in a suspected plot against an RAF airbase used by US forces to strike Iran. Separately, Netanyahu told UAE President Mohammed bin Zayed that Israeli intelligence shows Iran is renewing its nuclear programme.

threads.label: Regime messaging: Nasrallah, Naghdi, Khamenei
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRIB pushed a Nasrallah-anniversary and Sacred Defence Week cycle, including a message to be read at Imam Reza's shrine and a Khamenei text on 'armed readiness' among Iranian nationalities. IRIB and Defa Press amplified Commander Naghdi's claim that the US and Israel have been 'at war with Iran for seven months' and lost, and IRIB claimed Trump confirmed US forces will leave Iraq.

threads.label: Iran domestic repression reporting
threads.summary: Iran International reported prisoners in a security ward at Isfahan's Dastgerd Prison are beaten with cables and metal rods and held in overcrowded windowless cells. It separately reported death-row protester Alireza Sepahi was shot four times during arrest and tortured in custody, and that two January protesters were executed on Wednesday.

events.title: Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations
events.summary: The Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is adopting a final rule amending the Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations to implement certain provisions of a January 10, 2020 Iran-related Executive order. This amendment also revises an existing definition and an existing exemption, and incorporates two exemptions from the January 10, 2020 Iran-related Executive order.

events.title: The Safer Affordable Fuel-Efficient (SAFE) Vehicles Rule III for Model Years 2022 to 2031 Passenger Cars and Light Trucks
events.summary: NHTSA, on behalf of the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT), is substantially recalibrating the Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) program to bring the program into compliance with the law and to remove previous regulatory distortions which have induced manufacturers to make design decisions that have neither aligned with market demand and the needs of American families nor have delivered the consistent improvements in the fuel economy performance of manufacturer fleets, as Congress intended. This recalibration finalizes amendments to fuel economy standards for light-duty vehicles for model years 2022- 2026 and MYs 2027-2031. This final rule also finalizes amendments to compliance aspects of the program, including to vehicle classification and other compliance pathways.

details.agencies: Transportation Department, National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
